key_findings: R647 contains a substantial prepared Privacy-to-Jobs dispatcher library, explicitly NOT DEPLOYED and not exported/activated.

R647 dispatcher cannot be cherry-picked unchanged into R20: queue metadata absent, integrity hash input changed, prior-grant evidence dropped, and source revocation timestamp conflated with outbox createdAt.
Jobs R923 receiver has v1 and v2 schemas but v2 does not accept/persist priorGrantReceiptHash or priorGrantEvidenceState.
Jobs receiver explicitly refuses to certify physical private output deletion and Storage write fence.
Privacy producer, Jobs receiver, Privacy ACK callable and R647 root outbox ACK are not yet reconciled into one accepted protocol.
Jobs R900 reproduces post-admission operator-withdrawal continuation; governing Privacy/legal policy remains open.
Worker auth, rollback, protected CI, deployed source/IAM and full cross-service acceptance remain separate release gates.

tests_and_evidence.note: R961 was documentation and source/PR metadata reconciliation only. Refer to master handoff for evidence grades and exact scopes.
